verdict.rationale: ClickUp's docs confirm that multiple views can be created, grouped, sorted and filtered at any level of the hierarchy (and mention Chat views), so the same work can be shown in several views. However, the pack never names board, list, calendar or timeline view types, or shows switching between them in the UI. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of board, calendar and timeline view types, documentation of switching views over the same tasks, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
